title: Use a more typesafe pattern for "static" values in render parameters

comments.body:
I agree with this.
Personally I prefer the first suggestion as long as `init` itself doesn't bring us much value.
If we can merge the usage of `init` and `render` into one `render` function, we can do in `render` what `init` used to do, for example, assigning variables using `helper`. And they will be done only once by using `isFirstRender`.
